timeline.text: Welcome to Overslept and Already Behind. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I overslept and I’m already behind.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind is racing through everything I need to do.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I feel panicked about being late.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep checking the clock and feeling worse.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels rushed and tense.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to catch up immediately.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me is already dreading how the day will go.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this morning feels chaotic.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: Everything feels urgent right now.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can slow down even while I move quickly.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Rushing internally will not make me faster.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: A late start doesn’t ruin the whole day.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can focus on the next single step.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can move with less panic.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can catch up without losing my composure.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: One rushed morning isn’t a disaster.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can breathe even while I hurry.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let the panic settle a little.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust myself to handle a rushed morning.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can keep a clear mind, even under pressure.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can recover this day.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can move efficiently without spiraling.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can find its rhythm again.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m capable of catching up calmly.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This morning doesn’t decide the rest of my day.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can reset, even mid-rush.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to move forward steadily.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
